title: Devfolio
fullDescription: A modern, interactive mobile application built with Flutter that serves as my personal software engineering portfolio and CV. Engineered with a Feature-First Clean Architecture approach, custom canvas rendering, and a cohesive design system.
keyFeatures: Adaptive Light & Dark theme with ThemeExtension

title: TempBox
fullDescription: An innovative mobile application that provides instant access to temporary, disposable email addresses. Designed to protect user privacy and keep personal inboxes clean from spam by automatically managing temporary mailboxes.
keyFeatures: Real-time inbox synchronization via REST API

title: sGym
fullDescription: A comprehensive mobile application developed using Flutter, designed to facilitate fitness center management, class scheduling, membership purchases, and trainer-client interactions. Engineered with a focus on scalability and maintainability using Clean Architecture and SOLID principles.
